policy: An advisory's indicators are attributed only to an actor the publisher names in the bundle itself; the naming sentence is quoted verbatim and must be present in the pinned bundle (checked at load). Matches are contextual annotations only — never ATT&CK features, never scored (ADR-0013 D1).

attributions.quote: CISA received three files for analysis obtained from a critical infrastructure compromised by the People’s Republic of China (PRC) state-sponsored cyber group known as Volt Typhoon.
attributions.scope: files recovered from one compromised critical-infrastructure environment; the publisher states the environment was compromised by the actor, not that the files are unique to it
